verses.en: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.pt: Estas são as últimas palavras de Davi. Disse Davi filho de Jessé, Disse aquele homem que foi levantado alto, O ungido do Deus de Jacó, O suave em cânticos de Israel:
verses.en_web: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the last words of David. David, the son of Jesse, says, the man who was lifted up on high, the man on whom the God of Jacob put the holy oil, the loved one of Israel's songs, says:

verses.en: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.pt: O espírito do SENHOR falou por mim, E sua palavra foi em minha língua.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
verses.en_bbe: The spirit of the Lord had voice through me, his word was on my tongue.

verses.en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
verses.pt: O Deus de Israel disse, Falou-me o Forte de Israel: O dominador dos homens será justo. Dominador em temor de Deus.
verses.en_web: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
verses.en_bbe: The God of Israel said, the word of the Rock of Israel came to me: When an upright king is ruling over men, when he is ruling in the fear of God,

verses.en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.pt: Será como a luz da manhã quando sai o sol, Da manhã sem nuvens; Quando a erva da terra brota Por meio do resplendor depois da chuva.
verses.en_web: shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
verses.en_bbe: It is as the light of the morning, when the sun comes up, a morning without clouds; making young grass come to life from the earth.

verses.en: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.pt: Não está minha casa com Deus? Pois ele fez comigo um pacto perpétuo, Ordenado em todas as coisas, e será guardado; pois não é dele que brotará toda a minha salvação e todo o meu desejo?
verses.en_web: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he doesn’t make it grow.
verses.en_bbe: For is not my house so with God? For he has made with me an eternal agreement, ordered in all things and certain: as for all my salvation and all my desire, will he not give it increase?

verses.en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.pt: Mas os malignos serão todos eles como espinhos arrancados, os quais ninguém toma com a mão;
verses.en_web: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand,
verses.en_bbe: But the evil-doers, all of them, will be like thorns to be pushed away, because they may not be gripped in the hand:

verses.en: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.pt: Em vez disso o que quer tocar neles, Arma-se de ferro e de haste de lança, e são queimados em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: But the man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
verses.en_bbe: But anyone touching them has to be armed with iron and the rod of a spear; and they will be burned with fire, every one of them.

verses.en: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.pt: Estes são os nomes dos valentes que teve Davi: Josebe-Bassebete, o taquemonita, principal dos capitães: era este Adino o eznita, que matou em uma ocasião sobre oitocentos homens.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of David's men of war: Ishbaal the Hachmonite, chief of the three; his axe was lifted up against eight hundred put to death at one time.

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.pt: Depois deste, Eleazar, filho de Dodô de Aoí, foi dos três valentes que estavam com Davi, quando desafiaram aos filisteus que se haviam juntado ali à batalha, e subiram os de Israel.
verses.en_web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.
verses.en_bbe: After him was Eleazar, the son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three great fighters, who was with David in Pas-dammim when the Philistines came together there for the fight; and when the men of Israel had gone in flight,

verses.en: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.pt: Este, levantando-se, feriu aos filisteus, até que sua mão se cansou, e ficou grudada em sua espada. Aquele dia o SENHOR fez grande salvação; e voltou-se o povo depois dele somente para tomar o despojo.
verses.en_web: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
verses.en_bbe: He was with David and went on fighting the Philistines till his hand became tired and stiff from gripping his sword: and that day the Lord gave a great salvation, and the people came back after him only to take the goods of the Philistines.

verses.en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.pt: Depois deste foi Samá, filho de Agé araíta: que havendo os filisteus se juntado em uma aldeia, havia ali um terreno cheio de lentilhas, e o povo havia fugido diante dos filisteus:
verses.en_web: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.en_bbe: After him was Shammah, the son of Ela the Hararite. And the Philistines came together in Lehi, where there was a bit of land full of seed; and the people went in flight from the Philistines.

verses.en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
verses.pt: Ele então se parou em meio do terreno e defendeu-o, e feriu aos filisteus; e o SENHOR fez uma grande salvação.
verses.en_web: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.
verses.en_bbe: But he kept his place in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack and overcame the Philistines: and the Lord gave a great salvation.

verses.en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.pt: E três dos trinta principais desceram e vieram em tempo da colheita a Davi à cova de Adulão: e o acampamento dos filisteus estava no vale de Refaim.
verses.en_web: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.en_bbe: And three of the thirty went down at the start of the grain-cutting, and they came to David at the strong place of Adullam; and the band of Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.pt: Davi então estava na fortaleza, e a guarnição dos filisteus estava em Belém.
verses.en_web: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.en_bbe: And at that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.

verses.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!
verses.pt: E Davi teve desejo, e disse: Quem me dera a beber da água da cisterna de Belém, que está à porta!
verses.en_web: David longed, and said, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
verses.en_bbe: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town!

verses.en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Então os três valentes irromperam pelo acampamento dos filisteus, e tiraram água da cisterna de Belém, que estava à porta; e tomaram, e trouxeram-na a Davi: mas ele não a quis beber, mas derramou-a ao SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the three men, forcing their way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David: but he would not take it, but, draining it out, made an offering of it to the Lord.

verses.en: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.pt: Longe seja de mim, ó SENHOR, que eu faça isto. Eis de beber eu o sangue dos homens que foram com perigo de sua vida? E não quis bebê-la. Os três valentes fizeram isto.
verses.en_web: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Far be it from me, O Lord, to do this; how may I take as my drink the life-blood of men who have put their lives in danger? So he would not take it. These things did the three great men of war.

verses.en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.pt: E Abisai irmão de Joabe, filho de Zeruia, foi o principal dos três; o qual levantou sua lança contra trezentos, que matou; e teve nome entre os três.
verses.en_web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
verses.en_bbe: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the thirty. He put to death three hundred with his spear, and he got for himself a name among the thirty.

verses.en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.pt: Ele era o mais preeminente dos três, e o primeiro deles; mas não chegou aos três primeiros.
verses.en_web: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
verses.en_bbe: Was he not the noblest of the thirty? so he was made their captain: but he was not equal to the first three.

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.pt: Depois, Benaia filho de Joiada, filho de um homem esforçado, grande em feitos, de Cabzeel. Este feriu dois leões de Moabe: e ele mesmo desceu, e feriu um leão em meio de um fosso no tempo da neve:
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
verses.en_bbe: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a fighting man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow:

verses.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.pt: Também feriu ele a um egípcio, homem de grande estatura; e tinha o egípcio uma lança em sua mão; mas desceu a ele com um cajado, e arrebatou ao egípcio a lança da mão, e o matou com sua própria lança.
verses.en_web: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.en_bbe: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a tall man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a stick, and pulling the spear out of the hands of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.pt: Isto fez Benaia filho de Joiada, e teve nome entre os três valentes.
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.en_bbe: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.

verses.en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.pt: Dos trinta foi o mais preeminente; mas não chegou aos três primeiros. E Davi o pôs em seu conselho.
verses.en_web: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
verses.en_bbe: He was honoured over the rest of the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three. And David put him over the fighting men who kept him safe.

verses.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.pt: Asael irmão de Joabe foi dos trinta; Elanã filho de Dodô de Belém;
verses.en_web: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.en_bbe: Asahel, the brother of Joab, was one of the thirty; and Elhanan, the son of Dodai, of Beth-lehem,

verses.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.pt: Samá harodita, Elica harodita;
verses.en_web: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.en_bbe: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

verses.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.pt: Heles paltita, Ira, filho de Iques, de Tecoa;
verses.en_web: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.en_bbe: Helez the Paltite, Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

verses.en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.pt: Abiezer de Anatote, Mebunai husatita;
verses.en_web: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.en_bbe: Abiezer the Anathothite, Sibbecai the Hushathite,

verses.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.pt: Zalmom aoíta, Maarai de Netofate;
verses.en_web: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.en_bbe: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

verses.en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.pt: Helebe filho de Baaná de Netofate, Itai filho de Ribai de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim;
verses.en_web: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.en_bbe: Heldai, the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

verses.en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.pt: Benaia piratonita, Hidai do ribeiro de Gaás;
verses.en_web: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
verses.en_bbe: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the valleys of Gaash,

verses.en: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.pt: Abi-Albom de Arbate, Azmavete barumita;
verses.en_web: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.en_bbe: Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth of Bahurim,

verses.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.pt: Eleaba de Saalbom, Jônatas dos filhos de Jásen;
verses.en_web: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.en_bbe: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, Jashen the Gunite,

verses.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.pt: Samá de Harar, Aião filho de Sarar de Harar.
verses.en_web: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
verses.en_bbe: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam, the son of Sharar the Hararite,

verses.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.pt: Elifelete filho de Aasbai filho do maacatita; Eliã filho de Aitofel gilonita;
verses.en_web: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.en_bbe: Eliphelet, the son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam, the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

verses.en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.pt: Hezrai do Carmelo, Paarai arbita;
verses.en_web: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.en_bbe: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Archite,

verses.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.pt: Igal filho de Natã de Zobá, Bani gadita;
verses.en_web: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.en_bbe: Igal, the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.pt: Zeleque de Amom, Naarai de Beerote, escudeiro de Joabe filho de Zeruia;
verses.en_web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.en_bbe: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, who had the care of the arms of Joab, son of Zeruiah,

verses.en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.pt: Ira itrita, Garebe itrita;
verses.en_web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.en_bbe: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.pt: Urias, o heteu. Entre todos, trinta e sete.
verses.en_web: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
verses.en_bbe: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in number.
